Public Consulting Group LLC (PCG) is a leading public sector solutions implementation and operations improvement firm that partners with health, education, and human services agencies to improve lives. Founded in 1986, PCG employs approximately 2,000 professionals throughout the U.S.—all committed to delivering solutions that change lives for the better. The firm is a member of a family of companies with experience in all 50 states, and clients in three Canadian provinces and Europe. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit .

The Consultant role combines business consulting, project management, systems implementation, and operational improvement responsibilities to help clients modernize program administration and achieve successful outcomes. The Consultant serves as a liaison between clients, program operations teams, business analysts, and technical resources to design, implement, and optimize technology solutions that support program enrollment, application processing, case management, provider management, financial administration, reporting, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a candidate who enjoys solving complex business challenges, improving processes through technology, and working directly with clients to deliver innovative solutions.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serves as a trusted advisor to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Supports the planning, execution, and monitoring of client engagements
  • Facilitate client meetings, workshops, and requirements gathering sessions
  • Analyze program operations and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Leads proposal writing teams, presentations, and solution demonstrations
  • Gather, document, and validate business and functional requirements
  • Translate business needs into detailed system requirements and configuration specifications
  • Manage project tasks, deliverables, timelines, and action items
  • Track project progress and communicate status to stakeholders and leadership
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality, schedule, and contractual requirements
  • Analyze operational and program data to identify trends and opportunities
  • Prepare client-facing reports and executive-level summaries
  • Reviews and be the expert in the business operations for service and efficiency improvements.
  • Manages small projects, staff and tasks with limited supervision while meeting and exceeding performance expectations.
  • Participates in sales motions related to the practice.

Required skills

  • Ability to use sound judgment in completing tasks and to seek guidance when needed.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work with large data sets with accurate results.
  • Ability to move projects forward within a specific timeline and budget while working at a detailed level.
  • Commitment to exceptional client service.
  • Creative problem-solving ability and a consultancy mindset.
  • Ability to interact with various levels of management and with clients.
  • Flexible, self-starter possessing intellectual curiosity.
  • Able to follow, critically evaluate, and improve upon current processes.
  • Ability to recognize issues and identify solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or 5 years’ experience required and Master’s degree (MPA or government focused MBA) preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Business Analysts

Working Conditions

  • Remote
  • Some travel required

The above is intended to describe the general contents and requirements of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all duties, responsibilities or skills of personnel so classified.

We aim to eliminate the lack of capital as a barrier to business growth. We make a significant impact on small business owners and founders by funding their businesses, transforming their lives and the countless lives in the communities surrounding these businesses.

Our vision is to build a consulting firm-style company that delivers expertise at eye level with C-Level executives and business owner clients.

Tasks

The Role

This is not a “customer support” role. This is a professional consulting role that has full ownership of their client's success. You will:

  • Own the client journey: Guide 40-60 clients at a time through credit repair, credit optimization, and the funding process with our partner banks.
  • Ensure accountability: Keep clients on track with strong accountability, deep care for their results, and of course your charm.
  • Cut through fog: Understand your clients and their businesses better than they do. Anticipate bottlenecks, address the missing crucial details, and guide them with structured checks and radical candor while not sacrificing their happiness.
  • Build outstanding partnerships: Develop long-term client relationships rooted in outstanding expertise, trust, authentic care, and clear communication.
  • Become a thought leader: Become a trusted advisor respected by your clients because you are a real nerd for everything finance, credit, and growing businesses.

Tools: Google Workspace, Excel, Zoom, Slack, ChatGPT

What Success Looks Like

  • 10+ Clients fulfilled and their success fees collected per month
  • 95%+ of your clients hit their funding milestone within projected timelines.
  • Trustpilot rating 4.5+ and 10% referral rate for your clients.

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

This role will not work for you if:

  • You want a cushy, comfortable client-support job to pay your bills.
  • You are the kind of person who is constantly overwhelmed with life.
  • You are a company jumper who switches jobs at the first feedback.
  • You need the rigid, pre-built systems of a big company to feel safe.
  • You need an office with on-site management to keep you productive and accountable.
  • You can't have hard conversations with clients in a respectful, caring way.
  • You don't enjoy integrating yourself into a team and contributing to a company’s culture.

Requirements

Preferred Backgrounds:

  • At least a Bachelor’s degree - preferably in business administration or finance
  • 2+ years of experience in business funding consulting, credit stacking, corporate banking, consulting, private equity, or another role with client-facing responsibility in a fast-paced environment
  • Familiarity with credit, lending, or financing processes preferred - bare minimum is understanding of a P&L.

Important values that you share with us:

  • Ownership: Take full responsibility, proactively, always.
  • Integrity: Do the right thing, no matter what.
  • Perseverance: Raise the standard - especially when it gets hard.
  • Innovation: Adapt and grow to become smarter, happier, and more successful.
  • Humility: Care about growth and your team more than about being right.

If these don’t describe you, this won’t be a fit. Please do not apply - you will waste your time!

Availability: 40-50 hours work week from Monday to Friday, US work hours, remote, availability to travel up to 4 times per year for one week.

Language: English - native or close to native. No strong foreign accent.

Benefits

Compensation:

We pay in line with our target industries consulting and finance, while offering tremendous flexibility and much better work-life balance thanks to a 40-50 hour work week. In return we expect the highest standards for the work and full devotion during those hours.

  • Base Salary: $60,000
  • On-Target Earnings with variable tied to # Clients Fulfilled and # Referrals:
    Good Performer: $106,000 (achievable after 6 months)
    High Performer: $163,000 (achievable from the 2nd year onwards for top performers)

Other Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work in US hours
  • W-2 conversion after 6 months (first 6 months will be 1099 / contract)
  • MBA-level finance & consulting education
  • Leadership track in under 2 years available with the right personal growth
  • Company retreats

Timeline

  • Onboarding: In-person week in Munich, Germany or New Jersey, USA.
  • Ramp up time: 2 weeks to receive first clients, ~6 months to full productivity

How to Apply

If you’re ready to own outcomes, raise the standard, and help build an empire, we’d love to meet you!

Please send us:

  • An updated CV
  • A short video explaining your honest, personal motivation for this position - why do you think this position aligns with your personal goals and life situation?

From there, the process will continue with:

  • An online skills assessment
  • A group interview
  • An interview with Sam (Founder and your hiring manager)

PARA Consulting is a people-centric consulting firm dedicated to helping businesses optimize technology, people, and processes. From full HR outsourcing and NetSuite ERP support to workforce planning and business process automation, PARA brings integrity, agility, and community into everything we do.

As a remote organization, we prioritize flexibility, outcomes, and sustainable growth for our clients and team members alike.

Why Choose PARA?

  • Growth Opportunities – Build expertise across domains, work on high-visibility projects, and shape scalable delivery processes.
  • True Strategic Impact – Be part of our clients’ long-term transformations, not just one-off projects.
  • Mentorship & Leadership Development – Opportunities to coach junior resources and help grow PARA.
  • Autonomy & Flexibility – We trust our team to deliver results
  • Remote-First Culture – Work from anywhere and connect meaningfully with global teammates.
  • Lean, Agile Operations – Skip corporate red tape, just make it happen.

About the Role

PARA Consulting is seeking an experienced HCM Principal Consultant to join our implementation team and lead our HCM practice delivery.

This role expands beyond a traditional HCM Lead position. In addition to serving as the Lead Consultant on complex client implementations, you will oversee all HCM projects across PARA Consulting, ensuring consistency, quality, and successful delivery at scale.

You will be responsible for driving functional excellence, guiding implementation teams, and acting as the senior functional authority across HCM engagements. This role combines hands-on consulting, project oversight, client advisory, and team leadership.

You will partner closely with technical leads, project managers, and leadership while serving as the highest-level functional expert for HCM clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Lead Consultant on HCM implementations from discovery through go-live
  • Oversee all active HCM projects, ensuring alignment with delivery standards, timelines, and quality expectations
  • Lead and review functional configurations across HCM modules
  • Create, review, and approve functional documentation, workflows, and UAT test scripts
  • Ensure compliance with SOC/SOX requirements and client-facing audit controls
  • Facilitate executive-level client workshops and business requirement sessions
  • Act as the escalation point for complex functional, compliance, or delivery issues
  • Partner with Project Management to monitor project health, risks, and success metrics
  • Mentor, coach, and provide functional guidance to HCM consultants across projects
  • Ensure consistency in implementation approach, documentation, and best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align business requirements with system capabilities

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, IT, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in HCM consulting or HR systems implementations
    (Rippling, Workday, NetSuite SuitePeople, ADP, UKG, or similar)
  • 2+ years of experience in a lead, senior, or supervisory role
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end HCM implementations
  • Strong experience creating and reviewing functional documentation and UAT test scripts
  • Solid knowledge of SOC/SOX compliance or internal control frameworks
  • Excellent stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into scalable HCM system configurations
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes and optimized HCM workflows

Preferred Qualifications

(Not required, but will make you stand out)

  • Relevant HCM certifications (e.g., Workday HCM, Rippling, ADP, UKG)
  • Experience overseeing multiple concurrent HCM implementations
  • Experience in multi-country or global HCM deployments
  • Knowledge of regional compliance requirements (GDPR, SOX, labor regulations)
  • Familiarity with payroll, tax, benefits administration, and open enrollment workflows
  • Experience with HR data migration and system integrations

A Day in the Life

You begin your day reviewing dashboards across all active HCM projects, quickly identifying risks, dependencies, and areas requiring attention. During your morning standup, you align with project managers and consultants, providing guidance on complex configurations and unblocking critical issues.

Mid-morning, you step into a high-priority client escalation call as the Lead Consultant, translating business concerns into clear functional solutions and ensuring delivery stays on track. You review a go-live readiness checklist for one client while advising another team on a challenging payroll or benefits configuration.

In the afternoon, you lead a cross-functional workshop to align technical and business teams, review implementation quality across projects, and mentor consultants on best practices. You close your day confident that all HCM projects under your oversight are progressing with clarity, consistency, and high delivery standards.
